{{Quote|Our ''blasters'' can't penetrate their ''shield'', but the droids are having ''no'' problem blasting us to shreds ''through'' it!|A sergeant describes the starships' failure|<ref name="IJ" />}}
A model of [[Color/Legends|silver]]-and-blue colored '''starfighter''' was used by the [[Gall planetary defense force|planetary defense force]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gall/Legends|Gall]]. They were built with two wings, [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]], and a [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] for a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="IJ" /> Between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Inside Job]]" takes place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which started in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', and depicts [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which she left during the events of "[[The Wrong Jedi]]," which took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] per {{FactFile2014|42|20 BBY 51-54|Jedi Temple bombing}}.</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a [[Battle of Gall (Clone Wars)|battle]] was fought on Gall in which the defense forces sided with the Republic. The [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were used to defend against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] attacking the moon, which included [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid, Mark Is]], a make of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] starfighter used by the Separatists.<ref name="IJ" />

The fighter's [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] could not penetrate the [[Unidentified deflector shield model|shields]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|generated]] by the Separatists' [[Shielded Separatist craft|lead craft]], which also protected several [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]]. A [[Unidentified Gall sergeant|sergeant]] in the defense force reported the problem to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and<ref name="IJ" /> his<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who then managed to disable the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], allowing the defense forces to defeat the Separatists.<ref name="IJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The starfighters appeared in "[[Inside Job]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] written by [[Rik Hoskin]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]] that was published by [[Titan Magazines]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.1|first issue of the sixth volume]] of the [[Star Wars Comic|'' Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic]] magazine series<ref name="IJ" /> on [[November 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="ReleaseDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.theforce.net/latestnews/story/New_UK_The_Clone_Wars_Comic_Announced_127300.asp|text=New UK The Clone Wars Comic Announced|author=Barrick, Mike|date=2009-04-11|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archivedate=20200812092247}}</ref>
